player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; you see only the opponent's card.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) each round, {max_rounds} round(s) total.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X is a positive integer <= your chip count.)
- Highest hidden card wins the pot at showdown.

round.announce:
### Raundi {current_round}/{max_rounds}
Kadi ya mpinzani wako ni: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Pea moja tu ya hatua iliyo ndani ya mabano, kwa mfano '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', au '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Ndũngĩhota [check] - ũrĩ na kĩhooto gĩa kũheana.
invalid_move.amount_min: Mũigana wa bet / raise no mũhaka ũkorũo ũrĩ ≥ 1.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Hakuna kitu cha kuomba; unaweza [check] badala yake.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Hũthĩra [bet X] kũhingũra; gũtirĩ bet ya kwambatĩria.
invalid_move.insufficient: Gũtirĩ mbeca cia kũigana nĩ ũndũ wa ikinya rĩu.

message.showdown_tie: Gũthurwo kwa mũbira: o erĩ {card}. Mũbango wa kũgayũkanĩra  mũndũ ũmwe agĩaga na {split} .

outcome.draw: Ciĩga cia mũigana ũmwe thutha wa tũcunjĩ twothe twa kĩrore.
